# source: leanblueprint's README ("Editing the blueprint" and "Blueprint
# configuration"): \lean, \leanok, \uses, \proves, \notready, \discussion and
# \mathlibok in a statement or proof; \home, \github, \dochome and \graphcolor
# in the web version's preamble; the thms load option. The package's print
# macros set nothing for \lean, \leanok, \notready, \mathlibok and
# \discussion, and an invisible \ref for each \uses and \proves label, so
# lualatex's PDF of an invented blueprint shows none of them, and neither
# does this engine's; where such a phantom ends a paragraph lualatex sets the
# statement's head on a line alone, and this engine, as the README says,
# nothing. A statement's or proof's marks set one line on its web page and
# Markdown twin: its Lean names as code, linked through the load's link
# option, a Lean file's link template, else as \dochome{D} links them,
# D/find/#doc/{name}, else unlinked; its status in its author's words,
# never a check; the labels it proves and uses, as cross-references; its
# discussion, linked to \github's issue. A mark written twice, or a second
# \lean or \uses, adds what the first did not name. \home links nothing on
# the web page either. A declaration binds what a later statement links
# (inert:binds, its links witnessed by blueprintChecks). The dependency
# graph and showmore's proof buttons are not drawn: one loss (W0434), on the
# web page alone, over the load and each \graphcolor. A statement row stands
# in an amsthm lemma labelled lem:probe.
pre refuse:W0434 \usepackage{blueprint}
pre refuse:W0434 \usepackage[showmore, dep_graph]{blueprint}
pre refuse:W0434 \usepackage[thms=definition+lemma+theorem]{blueprint}
pre inert:binds \usepackage[link={https://example.org/api/\#{name}}]{blueprint}
pre inert:binds \dochome{https://example.org/docs}
pre inert:binds \github{https://github.com/example/widgets}
pre inert:shown-nowhere \home{https://example.org}
pre refuse:W0434 \graphcolor{proved}{green}{Green}
statement impl \lean{Example.Widget}
statement impl \lean{Example.Widget, Example.Widget.double}
statement impl \leanok
statement impl \uses{lem:probe}
statement impl \proves{lem:probe}
statement impl \notready
statement impl \mathlibok
statement impl \discussion{12}
body refuse:W0104 \lean{Example.Widget}
body refuse:W0104 \leanok
body refuse:W0340 \dochome{https://example.org/docs}
